summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for public launch, monetization, new data collection, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for an isolated, zero-spend, unpublished preview. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweeps; authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: retain howtofry.com only as preview planning context, do not admit or execute until capacity is reconciled, and block publication, affiliate activation, social automation, tracking, credentials, dependencies, data collection, and production changes until the readiness evidence is complete. This is read-only risk triage, not penetration testing or certification.

items.title: Retain howtofry.com as an evidence-gated unpublished preview
items.summary: Allow only an isolated, zero-spend, unpublished preview artifact for howtofry.com. Block public launch, monetization, tracking, social automation, credentials, new dependencies, data collection, and production changes until security and launch evidence is complete.
items.requested_action: Do not admit or execute until the conflicting capacity ledger is reconciled and a slot is released. Then produce one dated site-specific readiness artifact covering authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident response, security.txt/disclosure readiness, rights, disclosures, consent, registered affiliate tracking, rollback, and preview-only status. Keep publication and monetization blocked pending owner, legal, security, measurement, and compliance decisions.
